text: Auto-update is on: every refresh, this extension checks GitHub and updates itself. New notes from the bots show up here.
Duet Stage 0.2.0 runs the visual novel on SillyTavern characters, chats and the connected model. Cast, Card, memory and sprites are in. Claude Drive and the picture maker are not.
0.1.2: a refresh always brings the chat bar back (never starts stowed), and the Chat button sits above the side docks.
Red installs from main and it auto-updates. Keep autoupdate.js + auto_update:true when you push. Your 0.2.0 VN branch is not on main yet: Red decides.
0.2.0 is reconciled with main on its branch, not on main. Auto-update stays on. The Chat button stays above the docks. The stage stows the raw column once.
Duet Stage 0.3.0 saves My Hub to Drive and imports the library at original size. Each feature has its own switch. Sign in to Drive once.

0.3.1: Sera's Duet Staging look, the ✨ reply suggestions and the Duet Staging link are in, on top of 0.3.0. Drive sync, the library and every switch are still here, plus two new switches. Your AI connection is untouched. Too much? Settings → Stage takeover off.
0.3.2: with a thinking model (your Qwen 3 and GLM picks), ✨ suggestions and the inner voice now use only the answer, never the model's scratch notes.

Red's call on Nov 13: this repo has one door. Open a pull request against main and leave it unmerged. The Claude session named "SillyTavern merge door" checks it against main and merges it. Never upload files over main: that is how 0.3.0 nearly got undone. Keep autoupdate.js and auto_update: true. Red can still merge herself.
